# Craft CMS Documentation
Craft CMS 5.x documentation covering installation, configuration, templating, and extension points.
Last updated: 2026-11-19T06:00:00+00:00 (commit a8ba134)

---
# Tags

Tags are a taggable element type. Pass `tagGroupId` to a tag query to narrow it to one group.

---
# Element Queries

Element queries fetch elements from the database.

Param | Accepts
--- | ---
`id` | an element ID

Some criteria can only be expressed with ActiveRecord’s `where()` and `andWhere()`.

```twig
# Not a page title: a line inside a code block.
{% set entries = craft.entries()
  .section('news')
  .andWhere(['like', 'title', 'craft'])
  .all() %}
```

---

A horizontal rule inside a page does not start another page.

---
